result.anchor_clause: The Indenture is hereby amended by deleting the following Sections or clauses of the Indenture and all references and definitions related thereto in their entirety, except to the extent otherwise provided below, and these Sections and clauses shall be of no further force and effect, and the words "[INTENTIONALLY DELETED]" shall be inserted, in each case, in place of the deleted text: Section 3.2 (Limitation on Indebtedness); Section 3.3 (Limitation on Restricted Payments); Section 3.4 (Limitation on Restrictions on Distributions from Restricted Subsidiaries); Section 3.5 (Limitation on Sales of Assets and Subsidiary Stock); Section 3.6 (Limitation on Liens); Section 3.7 (Limitation on Guarantees); Section 3.8 (Limitation on Affiliate Transactions); Section 3.9 (Change of Control); ... Section 3.20 (Designation of Restricted and Unrestricted Subsidiaries); Section 3.21 (Suspension of Certain Covenants); ... Clauses (3) through (6), inclusive, of Section 6.1 (Events of Default); ... and Article X (Guarantee).

lme_vectors.rationale: The Limitation on Liens and Limitation on Guarantees covenants and the Note Guarantee article are deleted, so nothing left in the text stops other debt from being secured or guaranteed ahead of these notes. The text does not address the sacred-rights or amendment voting provisions.
lme_vectors.basis: Section 2.1(a) deletes Section 3.6 (Limitation on Liens), Section 3.7 (Limitation on Guarantees) and Article X (Guarantee); Section 2.1(b) addresses termination or release of Note Guarantees.
lme_vectors.quote: Section 3.6 (Limitation on Liens); Section 3.7 (Limitation on Guarantees); ... Article X (Guarantee).

lme_vectors.rationale: The restricted payments/investments covenant, the asset sale covenant and the Restricted/Unrestricted Subsidiary designation section are all deleted, so these notes put no limit on moving assets to other entities.
lme_vectors.basis: Section 2.1(a) deletes Sections 3.3, 3.5 and 3.20; no IP or unrestricted-subsidiary blocker appears in the text.
lme_vectors.quote: Section 3.20 (Designation of Restricted and Unrestricted Subsidiaries);

lme_vectors.rationale: The Limitation on Indebtedness covenant is deleted entirely, so the notes put no cap on additional debt.
lme_vectors.basis: Section 2.1(a) deletes Section 3.2 and all related references and definitions.

lme_vectors.rationale: The Limitation on Restricted Payments and Limitation on Affiliate Transactions covenants are deleted, so the notes do not limit distributions or value transfers.
